title: A stated Postgres connection budget, warned about and measured with many processes
description: Each worker holds its liveness connection and a hint-listener connection for good plus its pool, so a stock Postgres (max_connections 100) is reached near 45 workers, not the 90 ARCHITECTURE.md states (an estimate from the code, unmeasured). The control-plane ladder ran in one process.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/running.md gives the connection formula per role
A process warns at startup when the cluster's registered processes approach max_connections
A multi-process variant of test/stress.sh measures connections and Postgres load at 50 workers
notes: Dropped (D-126 and the pivot, D-107): Rule 14: no failure seen now (the 45-worker figure is an estimate). Moved to the backlog, to return when a deployment nears it.
